## Scientific release status
**DRAFT — NOT APPROVED AS FINAL SCIENTIFIC FIGURES.** These are AI-generated illustrative rasters, not real photographic evidence, measured plots or editable scientific vector figures. Placement in Google Slides is **not** certification of scientific, theoretical, mechanism-arrow, typography, or Deck3 palette compliance. No source facts or numerical results were newly validated in this operation. Slides 5 and 8 have high-priority science blockers; all ten have colored panel/gradient effects inconsistent with Deck3 white surface/palette rules. Independent projector-scale, accessibility, ASU caption-overlay, adjacent citations and rights/provenance reviews remain open. Approval requires new corrected scientific art and verification, not simply masking warnings.

**Design routing:** This visual review copy is separate from the original official ASU Google Slides working deck. Do not automatically overwrite the original or merge these draft figures into a released defense deck without science QA and explicit release authorization.
